economy.summary: His campaign platform lists increasing the minimum wage, improved access to and support for child care, paid parental leave, and promoting unions. It also lists fighting predatory lending, preventing price gouging by corporate housing interests, and consumer right-to-repair.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, paid parental leave, child care, unions.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform states he would "tax corporations and billionaires to lower taxes for the working class." It also supports exempting 100 percent disabled veterans from property taxes and military spouses from state and local income taxes.
taxes.short: Proposes taxing corporations and billionaires to lower working-class taxes.

abortion.summary: His campaign platform lists "Protect right to choose" under Protecting Rights and Freedoms. The platform does not detail specific legislation.
abortion.short: Supports protecting the right to choose.

education.summary: His campaign platform lists funding schools and preventing privatization of school systems. It also lists supporting relief for school loans and expansion of community college and trade school options.
education.short: Supports funding schools, opposes privatization, expands community college options.

healthcare.summary: His campaign platform lists keeping rural hospitals open and preventing monopolization of healthcare. The platform does not detail specific legislation.
healthcare.short: Supports keeping rural hospitals open; opposes healthcare monopolization.

energy.summary: His campaign platform lists stopping data centers from raising energy costs, under an affordability heading. It also lists preventing privatization of water and other public services.
energy.short: Would stop data centers raising energy costs; opposes water privatization.

guns.summary: His campaign platform lists promoting and protecting responsible gun ownership, and separately lists removal of civil forfeiture laws. The platform does not detail specific firearms legislation.
guns.short: Supports promoting and protecting responsible gun ownership.

economy.summary: At a July 2026 telephone town hall she said she supports a bipartisan bill imposing a $500 monthly fee on skill game terminals and capping them at 50,000 statewide, and expects it to return when the legislature reconvenes in September. She cited a district pizza shop she said pays employees a larger wage because of the machines.
economy.short: Supports bipartisan bill to fee and cap skill game terminals.

taxes.summary: Her campaign site lists "Oppose Tax Hikes and Reckless State Spending" among her priorities.
taxes.short: Opposes tax hikes and what she calls reckless state spending.

abortion.summary: Her campaign site lists "Defend Life at all Stages" among her priorities and describes her as 100 percent pro-life.
abortion.short: Describes herself as pro-life; would defend life at all stages.

education.summary: When accepting the Republican nomination in January 2026, she said she would work to provide resources for public schools to educate students on "what matters," and described protecting the competitiveness of women's sports among her positions.
education.short: Would provide public school resources; protect women's sports competitiveness.

energy.summary: Her campaign site lists "Explore, Extract, and Preserve Pennsylvania Energy" among her priorities. In January 2026 she stated support for safe and responsible resource extraction.
energy.short: Supports exploring and extracting Pennsylvania energy; backs responsible extraction.

guns.summary: She is prime sponsor of House Bill 2599 of the 2025-2026 session, vehicle open carry legislation amending Title 18 provisions on carrying firearms without a license, referred to the House Judiciary Committee in June 2026. Her campaign site describes her as 100 percent pro-Second Amendment.
guns.short: Prime sponsor of vehicle open carry bill; pro-Second Amendment.
